flows:
Navigate to https://www.nationalrail.co.uk/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
At 320px width, assert the Open search control fits within the visible width without horizontal scrolling.
Activate Open search and verify a search field becomes available, or assert the From station field of the journey planner fits and accepts text.
